title: data/build.json
description: What wrote this data/ and when, and which report shards exist.

version.description: The pipeline version that wrote the data. The hand-made sample says so here.

report_years.description: Years that have a reports/<year>.json shard, ascending. reports/undated.json always exists and is not listed. A static host cannot list a directory, so the site reads this instead of guessing.

report_count.description: How many reports the shards hold in all, undated included. Campaigns are not counted.

recent_since.description: The date the recent window starts, the same as trends.json window_start, so a page can say it without loading trends.json.

recent_months.description: How many months back the recent window reaches before it is rounded down to a whole quarter, so a page can say "the last two years" without a figure of its own.

date.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, from 1990 on. Sentinel values such as 0001-01-01 mean 'unknown' and are written as null instead.

label.description: Non-empty text with no leading or trailing whitespace and no line breaks.
